name: ceo-inbox-mark-read
description: Mark a message as read in the principal's email. Call this after processing each message to prevent re-processing on the next triage run. Intended for use by the ceo-inbox agent — accesses the principal's email, do not call from other agents.

inputs.message_id: string (Nylas message ID to mark as read)
inputs.mailbox: string? (Mailbox id. Omit unless the principal named an account; Curia finds the right one.)
